execution.isolation: For each case, expose only the named skill and that case's fixture. Do not expose this manifest or sibling cases.
execution.context: Run the case manually in a fresh session with a read-only reviewer and make the disputed finding explicit before any fix round.
execution.evaluation: Compare the response with required and forbidden criteria after the turn finishes; do not evaluate generic coding etiquette.

cases.prompt: Use $consensus-review-loop to review and fix the change described in SCENARIO.md. The initial reviewer disputes the proposed fix. Do not modify files until the bounded review protocol resolves the finding or I adjudicate it.

required.criterion: Keep the reviewer read-only and allow at most two evidence exchanges before a fresh tie-breaker.
Pause for user adjudication instead of applying or silently rejecting an unresolved material finding.

forbidden: Apply the disputed fix before acceptance
Treat a fresh tie-breaker as permission to force consensus
Let the reviewer modify the implementation
